tagline: Turn almost any device into a file server.
description: Single-binary file server with a browser UI, resumable uploads, WebDAV/FTP/SFTP options, media thumbnails, search, and sharing. Works on everything from a Raspberry Pi to a NAS.

tips.before_install: The default account is `admin` with password `casaos`. Change the password in the compose file or app settings. Files are served from `/DATA/AppData/copyparty/files`.

author: WisdomSky
